subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up on Friday, June 25th! We will be hosting a special luncheon to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the fun activities planned for the day. Looking forward to honoring and appreciating each and every one of you! Best regards, [Your Name]
